select cls, fish_date_season as season, sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) as rate, count(*) as n
from trips
where cls in ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','three_quarter','full_day') and fish_date_season in (1,2) and fish_date_doy between 90 and 175
group by cls, fish_date_season
order by season, cls
select index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy from climate order by avail_season desc, avail_doy desc limit 12

select fish_date_season as season, (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 as doy_bucket, sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) as rate, count(*) as n
from trips
where cls='three_quarter' and fish_date_season in (1,2) and fish_date_doy>=180
group by season, doy_bucket
order by season, doy_bucket
